about_the_game:
Wake up in a magical wasteland where the remnants of ancient power still linger. With only your tools and your courage, build a moving home and embark on a journey across forests, frozen plains, and forgotten ruins. Travel with your friends, gather resources, and survive together as you face challenges from nature and mythical creatures.

Features

  • Build Your Moving Castle – Craft and customize your own mobile base. Add legs, balloons, or sleds to travel across different terrains.

  • Explore a Vast World – Discover forests, snowfields, caves, and ancient ruins filled with secrets and dangers.

  • Survive the Wilderness – Gather resources, farm, fish, and defend yourself against hostile creatures.

  • Co-op with Friends – Team up with 2–6 players, travel together, and share the adventure.

  • Dynamic Encounters – Face monsters, guardians, and environmental hazards that test your strategy and teamwork.

  • Freedom to Play – Focus on survival, exploration, or building – the world is open to your choices.
